x: Since our last issue we welcome new lads to our fold; Ian Boss, Harold Burton, Dennis Ives, Patrick Maloney, Gordon Smith and Harry Stallard, also the return of Alf Joels who has resumed his membership.

Denis Ives, who should not have started with the heavy cold he had, is certainly a likely prospect with steady training. Len Demmon was our first man to finish in the "A" section which was won by Coleman of Highgate who covered 8 miles, 76 yards, an excellent performance.
One between Ives (not Wally) and Harry Shields over the last few laps, and the other between Eric Hall and Syd James for practically the whole of the distance.
I would like to see more of Dennis Ives on the track and some of the other youngsters who came along towards the end of the last track season.

Denis Ives is still coming along well but we certainly need some new blood for our Surrey Teams. I am sure some of our members who don't shine too well at running would find no end of enjoyment in walking and even progress to first class performers if only they would try it out for a while.
Denis Ives, improving on every turn out. 2nd Charlie Speechley, still going strong.
The handicap was won by Stan Vickers off 2.40. with Denis Ives 2nd and George Beecham 3rd.

Dennis Ives is also in Germany and we hope still keeping fit. Space is too limited to mention all the good performances during the past three months, but if your name is not in print and you think it ought to be, then accept my apologies.
